script:
set -eu
echo PWD=$PWD
echo '--- branch ---'
git branch --show-current || true
echo '--- HEAD ---'
git log -1 --format='%h %s'
echo '--- status ---'
git status --short
echo '--- refs containing HEAD ---'
git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' --contains HEAD refs/heads refs/remotes || true
